notes: I changed the model to add a piecewise region: for |x| < 1.5 the box returns roughly a constant ~3.3 (noisy, no clear cubic or odd structure per E6), while outside that interval it follows the pure odd cubic a·x³+c·x. E6 showed the small-x outputs cluster around 3–4 rather than the near-zero cubic values, so the cubic rule only holds for |x| ≥ ~1.5.
